source.title: GEBCO_2026 Grid, ice-surface-elevation version
source.vertical_reference: heterogeneous source elevations treated by GEBCO as mean sea level; shallow-water exceptions may exist
source.units: m elevation; negative below nominal mean sea level
source.license: public domain with requested attribution and disclaimer

sampling.method: nearest GEBCO pixel center to each approximate OSW display seed
sampling.tie_rule: exact half-cell ties select the north/east center
sampling.seed_status: approximate display placement, not published Longhurst geometry or a province centroid

boundary: Each value describes one GEBCO grid cell nearest an approximate display seed. It is not a province mean, range, profile, occupancy fraction, navigational sounding, or statement about the whole province.
